classification.difficultyReason: Construct a tangent at the specified x-value, choose readable points on it, and calculate rise over run using the different axis scales. The taught method supplies the approach, but tangent placement requires graphical judgment.

content.prompt: The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown. Estimate $f'(3)$.

spec.description: Editable reconstruction of the source's unspecified curve using approximate graph readings. Preserve the first-quadrant axes, arrowheads, numbered scales and dotted major and minor grids. No tangent is supplied.
spec.mathematics: Increasing concave-up curve near the origin, approximately through (3,5.3) and (4.5,18). Horizontal major step 0.5 and minor step 0.1; vertical major step 2 and minor step 0.4. No equation is asserted.
spec.answerVisibility: The curve and grid are permanent givens; the tangent and gradient calculation appear only in solutions.

answer.worked:
Draw a tangent to the curve at $x=3$. Two approximate points on this tangent are $(2,0.3)$ and $(4,10.3)$.
$$\begin{align*}f'(3)&\approx\frac{10.3-0.3}{4-2}\\&=5.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Solution tangent and rise/run triangle in the exact base graph coordinate frame and bounding box.
spec.mathematics: Approximate tangent y=5x-9.7 through (3,5.3), with rise 10 and run 2 between (2,0.3) and (4,10.3).
